ideas.children_he: אַבְרָם חָזַר לְאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן וּפָקַד אֶת הַמָּקוֹם שֶׁבּוֹ הִתְפַּלֵּל. לִפְעָמִים חֲזָרָה לְמָקוֹם מֻכָּר מְחַזֶּקֶת אוֹתָנוּ.
ideas.children_en: Abram returned with his family and belongings, his wealth grew, and he visited the altar he built to remember, thank God, and tell others about Him.

ideas.children_he: לְאַבְרָם וּלְלוֹט הָיוּ עֲדָרִים רַבִּים, וְהָרוֹעִים שֶׁלָּהֶם רָבוּ. כְּשֶׁאֵין מַסְפִּיק מָקוֹם לְכֻלָּם, עָלוּל לְהִתְפַּתֵּחַ רִיב.
ideas.children_en: Lot also had his own property, but they needed a lot of grazing land. Their herders fought because of little space and fear others in the land would harm them using the fight as chance.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָם הִצִּיעַ לְלוֹט לְהִפָּרֵד כְּדֵי לִשְׁמֹר עַל הַשָּׁלוֹם. לִפְעָמִים וִתּוּר קָטָן מוֹנֵעַ רִיב גָּדוֹל.
ideas.children_en: Abram feared the herders' fights would cause problems between them. He invited Lot to choose left or right so they would not argue.

ideas.children_he: לוֹט בָּחַר אֵזוֹר פּוֹרֶה וְאַבְרָם נִשְׁאַר בִּכְנַעַן. כָּל אֶחָד בָּחַר דֶּרֶךְ אַחֶרֶת, אֲבָל הֵם הִפְסִיקוּ לָרִיב.
ideas.children_en: Lot chose to live in the fertile Jordan plain near Sodom with lots of plants. Abram stayed in Canaan near Bethel, and they went their own ways.

ideas.children_he: אֱלֹהִים הִבְטִיחַ לְאַבְרָם אֶרֶץ וּמִשְׁפָּחָה גְּדוֹלָה. הַבְטָחָה לֶעָתִיד יְכוֹלָה לָתֵת כֹּחַ בַּהוֹוֶה.
ideas.children_en: God promised Abram that the land he sees will be his and his offspring's forever. His offspring will be many, like the dust of the earth. Even if others live there, Abram can feel safe like at home.

ideas.children_he: אַבְרָם עָבַר לְאֵזוֹר חֶבְרוֹן וּבָנָה מִזְבֵּחַ. גַּם כְּשֶׁהַמָּקוֹם מִשְׁתַּנֶּה, אֶפְשָׁר לִשְׁמֹר עַל הָאֱמוּנָה.
ideas.children_en: Abram moved in Mamre near Hebron, kept believing in God, built altars, and called on God's name.
